hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, the hook fully manages the trade: it takes input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, enforces a custom curve invariant, and returns the full swap delta to the pool manager — bypassing Uniswap's concentrated liquidity entirely.
